第56章 路不太平，请多担待-《系统送编，从外卖员成007探员》

顾承安快速翻身闪入保安亭，落地时膝盖微屈缓冲，脚掌贴地不发出半点声响，身体顺势贴紧保安亭内壁，快速扫视亭内两人位置。

坐着看手机的安保第一个遭殃——一只手精准扣住他的后颈，拇指压在特定位置，指腹发力按压神经节点，对方连哼都没哼一声，脑袋直接歪向一边，瘫软在椅子上。

顾承安顺势扶了一把椅背，避免椅子摩擦地面出声。

站着那个反应稍快半拍，脚刚挪动半步，嘴刚张开想要呼喊，一个肘击已经精准砸在他颈侧大动脉处，闷哼一声，人往后倒。

顾承安一把拽住他的衣领，小臂发力稳稳拖住对方身体，缓缓放到地面，没让他摔出声。

两人全部失去意识。

前后加起来，不超过四秒。

顾承安掏出事先浸好迷药的毛巾，分别捂住二人的口鼻，停留十秒左右。

再抬手探了探两人颈动脉，确认呼吸平稳、药效生效，这东西能保证至少三个小时内不会醒来。

搞定门口，下一个目标——院内巡逻。

他猫着腰沿围墙内侧移动，脊背紧贴墙面，脚步交替压低重心，每一步都踩在草坪与石板的缝隙处，避开碎石子。

借着花坛和景观树的遮挡，身形在阴影里快速穿梭，每隔几米就停顿半秒观察四周动向，迅速接近西侧。

两名巡逻安保正并肩走在石板小路上，步伐匀速，目光扫过院落四周，毫无防备。

顾承安从一棵棕榈树后闪出，身体压低贴紧树干，脚步无声落地，一步步缩短距离，屏住呼吸。

左边的安保突然觉得脖子后面一凉——手指精准触碰颈侧神经，力道猛的灌入，身体瞬间失去支撑力，直接软倒。

旁边的同伴转头的动作刚做到一半，顾承安另一只手已经挥出，迷药毛巾死死贴捂住了他的口鼻，同时手肘顶住对方后背，限制其挣扎动作。

很快，他的肢体力道快速消散，也软了下去，顾承安伸手扶住两人身体，轻轻靠在路边花坛上，避免倒地发出声响。

给另一个也捂住口鼻，彻底迷晕。

四个了。

还剩三个，楼下两个，楼上一个。

顾承安来到别墅正门前，门是虚掩的，安保人员自己进出方便，没上锁。

从系统空间掏出一个小油瓶，倒在门轴处，好了之后放回空间里。

Gu Chengan quickly turned over and ducked into the security booth. When he landed, his knees were slightly bent for cushioning. His soles touched the ground without making any sound. He pressed his body against the inner wall of the security booth and quickly scanned the positions of the two people in the booth.

The security guard who was sitting and looking at his cell phone was the first to suffer - a hand clasped the back of his neck precisely, his thumb pressed on a specific position, and his fingertips pressed hard on the nerve nodes. The other person didn't even hum, his head tilted to the side, and he slumped on the chair.

Gu Chengan took advantage of the situation and held the back of a chair to prevent the chair from rubbing against the ground.

The standing man reacted half a beat faster, and as soon as he moved his feet half a step, and just opened his mouth to shout, an elbow hit the main artery on the side of his neck accurately, and with a muffled groan, he fell back.

Gu Chengan grabbed his collar, used his forearm to firmly drag the other person's body, and slowly lowered him to the ground, preventing him from falling down.

Both of them lost consciousness.

Adding up the time before and after, no more than four seconds.

Gu Chengan took out a towel that had been soaked in drug beforehand and covered their mouths and noses respectively for about ten seconds.

Then he raised his hand to explore the carotid arteries of the two people to confirm that their breathing was stable and the medicine was taking effect. This thing can guarantee that they will not wake up for at least three hours.

After securing the door, the next goal is to patrol the courtyard.

He bent his waist and moved along the inside of the wall, keeping his back close to the wall. He lowered his center of gravity alternately with his steps, stepping on the gap between the lawn and the stone slabs with each step to avoid gravel.

Blocked by flower beds and landscape trees, the figure quickly shuttled in the shadows, pausing for half a second every few meters to observe the surrounding movements, and quickly approached the west side.

Two patrolling security guards were walking side by side on the stone path, walking at a steady pace, looking around the courtyard, unprepared.

Gu Chengan stepped out from behind a palm tree, lowered his body close to the trunk, and landed silently, shortening the distance step by step and holding his breath.

The security guard on the left suddenly felt a chill on the back of his neck - his fingers accurately touched the nerves on the side of his neck, and the force poured in so hard that his body instantly lost its support and collapsed directly.

The companion next to him had just turned his head halfway when Gu Chengan had already waved out his other hand, and the drugged towel tightly covered his mouth and nose. At the same time, he put his elbow on the opponent's back to restrict his struggling movements.

Soon, the strength of his limbs dissipated quickly and he softened. Gu Chengan reached out to support the two of them and leaned gently on the flower bed by the roadside to avoid making a sound when they fell to the ground.

He covered the mouth and nose of the other one and was completely stunned.

Four already.

There are three left, two downstairs and one upstairs.

Gu Chengan came to the main entrance of the villa. The door was ajar and it was not locked for the security personnel to enter and exit easily.

Take out a small oil bottle from the system space, pour it on the door axis, and then put it back into the space.
